greek_verification: Adopted SGCT unanimously reads first-person possessives μου twice in Lev 26:46: Ταῦτα τὰ κρίματά μου καὶ τὰ προστάγματά μου, καὶ ὁ νόμος ὃν ἔδωκεν Κύριος ἀνὰ μέσον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σεινὰ ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ. (Swete-Amicarelli, 1st1K-LXX, Swete [B/A/א], Sixtine/Brenton, LXX-Orthodox). Closing the divine speech before 26:46 would place first-person "My judgments and My ordinances" in the narrator's mouth.
resolution: Harmonized cross-chapter quote boundaries with Lev 4:35->5:1 and 6:23->7:1 by closing both nested quotes ('") at 25:55, reopening " at 26:1, and closing " at 26:46 (removing the now-closed inner single quote), and added a factual translator note on 26:46 explaining the unanimous LXX first-person possessives shifting into the third-person Sinai colophon. Resolves the last 2 odd-quote chapters across all 1,291 chapters.

greek_verification: Adopted SGCT Neh 12:8 ends unpunctuated (...ἐπὶ τῶν χειρῶν αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ) and 12:9 continues directly in lowercase (εἰς τὰς ἐφημερίας.) as a single prepositional clause ("he and his brothers were over the hands for the divisions.").
resolution: Lowercased Neh 12:9 "For the divisions." -> "for the divisions." to match the adopted Greek clause continuation.
